zh-CN.title: 科研资源空间焕新
items: 资源空间新增目录卡片、搜索、分类与排序，概览和任务页展示资源摘要
群聊入口移至成员头像右侧，群聊详情中的课题入口独立展示，完善负责人转让流程

en.title: A refined research library
items: Browse folder cards, search and filter resources, with resource summaries in project and task views
Open group chat beside member avatars, access project settings in a separate section, and transfer ownership more reliably
